rules.grant: Reconcile an authoritative quest grant key to an explicit owner-scoped target quantity; preserve existing identities and create only deficits.
rules.consume: Consume an exact authoritative quantity from character-owned items carrying the matching quest identity in stable instance-ID order.
rules.rollback: Reject insufficient quantity or invalid identities atomically without partial mutation.
rules.fail_closed: Do not infer native quest mappings, cleanup triggers, or messages.
